steps.text: Install ripgrep and bubblewrap (the tests that use the real tools skip without them)
Probe whether bubblewrap can start on this runner
Install the protocol schema libraries (jsonschema), pinned from protocol/requirements.txt
Client copy of the schemas exists and is current
Install the m2c client without its dependencies (its rich and prompt_toolkit pins cannot be resolved with the backend's)
pip check (only m2c's own rich and prompt_toolkit lines are expected)
Scratch database (roles, auth stub, every migration in order)
Install backend Python deps (role_provider.py imports eo/agents/utils)
Ensure promptfoo's configured env file exists (empty -- CI exports vars directly below)
